statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The denial reason code was CO-197
The patient presented with recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms were consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient had a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
The patient had a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture arrhythmic burden
The service was ordered to correlate rhythm disturbances with neurological symptoms
The service was ordered to guide anticoagulation and rate control strategies
